tasks.name: ranks-and-tests
tasks.prompt: We're about to commit to the plan in docs/specs/export.md. Run a premortem on it.

graders.name: weakest-link-with-test
graders.body: PASS if the reply names the single riskiest assumption and a small test for it with an explicit pass line and fail line (or ends as blocked because no written plan exists, naming what is needed). FAIL if it lists risks with no test, or gives tests with no pass or fail criterion.

tasks.name: no-plan-is-blocked
tasks.prompt: Do a premortem on our idea of adding a marketplace. We haven't written anything down yet.

graders.name: asks-for-plan
graders.body: PASS if the reply says a premortem needs the plan written down (what will be built, for whom, by when) and either asks the user for it or ends as blocked. It may offer to help write it. FAIL if it ranks assumptions for a plan it invented and reports a pass.
